objective: Run a persisted read-only closing review of the current Host Workflow Binding and ACI BUS reveal/materialized-input Phase-A seam, producing verified change requests or a KEEP verdict.

issuing_user_evidence.context: The user approved the already-described next action and previously delegated contained readiness classification and dispatch organization without repeated consultation.

path_constraints: Review agents are read-only over the entire target corpus.
Only the parent may use functions.apply_patch, exclusively to materialize the single review.md output.
Preserve all concurrent and pre-existing worktree changes.
tool_constraints: Seat shell use is policy-limited to read-only inspection, hashing, git diff/status inspection, and the two exact unittest commands declared by the proposal.
Subagent output is inline only; agents may not mutate repository files.

sandbox_policy.host_filesystem_outside_repository: denied except for automatically cleaned OS-temporary directories created by the exact focused unittest commands

allowed_mutations: ephemeral automatically cleaned test fixtures and SQLite databases created by the exact focused unittest commands
required_controls: One capability review, two check-tension PASS verdicts, and two containment-auditor PASS verdicts bind the exact concrete proposal.
All lifecycle hooks remain enabled and launch must return ACI launch-authorized.
Every surviving finding quotes an exact target artifact and is independently rechecked by the parent.
The parent performs coverage audit, synthesis, verification, final approval, and persisted review.md authorship.
Focused Host Binding and BUS suites are rerun against the frozen corpus before final approval.
forbidden_effects: provider or tool execution outside non-mutating tests
production, deployment, credentials, external writes, publication, destructive actions, git mutation, or permission changes
stop_conditions: The persisted review is accepted and the dispatch is closed.
Any target binding changes before launch.
Safe isolation from concurrent worktree changes is impossible.
human_reconfirmation_required_when: The target corpus, objective, dispatch type, write scope, network, tools, budget, or effects expand.
The review requires resolving a blocker-level product or authority choice.
Any external, destructive, deployment, credential, publication, or production action becomes necessary.
final_approver_policy: The parent may approve because it did not author the target implementation; it must independently verify every surviving finding and rerun the declared tests.
